messages:
maria_p: Hey team — PolarGrid confirmed the EAP for their EdgeBox v2 HW next week. NDA signed yesterday by legal. We need: benchmarks plan, telemetry hook, marketplace listing checklist, and an embargo date for a joint announcement.

jake_eng: Nice. Do we have rack access details? Also need model variants we'll validate (gpt2-medium, redwood-mini, redwood-large?)

kenji_ml: For benchmarking I'd propose: perf (p50/p95 latency), throughput (tokens/s), memory profile, and perf under KV-cache warm vs cold. Also quantized runs (int8) if EdgeBox supports it.

olivia_sre: @maria_p ping — we should add a network egress test and time-to-first-byte from eu-west1. Edge sites are flaky sometimes.

maria_p: Good call. PolarGrid asked about marketplace timing — they want the listing in their marketplace on day of announcement. Nina, you on marketplace flow?

nina_product: Yep. I'll prepare the listing draft. Need approved logo, short blurb, and a lead contact email. Also need the trial SKU and pricing guidance for EAP.

jake_eng: I'll prep a lightweight harness. Plan to run: 3x 64-token prompts, 3x 512-token prompts, batch sizes 1/8/16. Script: ```bash
./bench.sh --model redwood-large --tokens 512 --batch 8 --runs 3
``` I'll publish artifacts to s3://redwood-eap/polargrid/bench-2410004321

kenji_ml: Add a quality eval too — we'll run 200 prompt pairs from our eval suite and track rouge/emd + hallucination rate. If quantization drops quality >2% we flag it.

maria_p: NDA note: PolarGrid legal wants us to sign the MPA addendum for marketplace listing. I uploaded it to Drive: https://drive.company/polargrid_mpa

olivia_sre: CI bot just ran a quick infra smoke and returned a port-blocked error. ```CI-BOT: port 9090 blocked on edgebox-03``` Can someone triage? @jake_eng

jake_eng: On it. Looks like iptables default from image. I'll open a change and ping infra.

kenji_ml: Timeline: bench runs on Tue, quantization pass Wed, draft marketplace Thurs, joint embargo + blog next Mon? Is that aggressive?

maria_p: PolarGrid prefers next Mon for announcement. We can aim for a soft embargo: internal preview Fri EOD, public Mon. If we hit blockers, contingency is a short-form blog + joint case study later.

nina_product: I'll sync with comms for a short announcement + marketplace listing. Need finalized bench numbers by Thurs EOD.

maria_p: Action items:
- jake_eng: bench harness + s3 artifacts (due Tue)
- kenji_ml: quality eval + quantization checks (due Wed)
- olivia_sre: infra open ports + e2e smoke (ASAP)
- nina_product: marketplace draft + comms sync (Thu)

ci-bot: Deployment pipeline note: new artifacts will trigger eap-deploy pipeline; tag with `polargrid-eap/2410004321` to avoid auto-promote.

maria_p: Thanks all. We'll have a short sync Mon 11am PT to confirm go/no-go. :thumbsup:
